name: GARCH
when_to_use: Financial/risk time series whose volatility varies over time (conditional heteroskedasticity); model the variance, not only the mean level.
notes: Models how volatility varies over time, not only the mean value. Applications: financial risk, commodity prices, series with variable "turbulence".

expected_input.question: How does the volatility of a series vary over time?

plain_explanation.purpose: Models the variation (volatility) of a series, which tends to come in calm and agitated waves.
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When the interest is risk, not the value itself.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of values or returns over time, many points.
plain_explanation.example: Estimate the daily volatility of a financial asset.
plain_explanation.diagram: calm ~~~ agitated ^^^ calm ~~~ (variation also has memory)
